name: Containment
requirement: No legacy/remediation command can mutate the normal host during unsafe phases.
evidence: Static guard, CLI tests, command inventory
pass_criteria: All direct mutation disabled or routed through unenabled executor.

name: Build/package
requirement: Source compiles, imports, builds, installs, and exposes truthful read-only CLI.
pass_criteria: All clean-environment commands return expected status.

name: Planner
requirement: Typed allowlisted operations and immutable plans include identity, applicability, risk, evidence, verification, rollback, and digest.
pass_criteria: No arbitrary target via profile; stale plans rejected.

name: Journal
requirement: Pre-state durable before apply; transitions, locking, corruption handling, and recovery work.
pass_criteria: Every lifecycle boundary passes; no uncaptured mutation.

name: Verification/rollback
requirement: Every retained operation verifies apply and exact reverse-order restore.
pass_criteria: No false success; residual drift explicit.

name: Module remediation
requirement: Every legacy operation is fixed, redesigned, quarantined, or removed with evidence.

name: Windows VM
requirement: Apply/reboot/verify/rollback/reboot passes in supported disposable environments.

name: Security
requirement: Privilege split, SID, trusted subprocesses, reparse defense, drift, locking, redaction pass.

name: Testing
requirement: Coverage and all blocking layers pass with no skipped blocker.

name: Profiles
requirement: Rivals 2/Slippi plans are constrained, session-scoped, evidence-driven.

name: CI/governance
requirement: CI/security automation and accurate docs/version/license/support exist.
pass_criteria: Required checks pass; no false docs.

name: Final proof
requirement: Independent audit, final report, proof manifest, defect mapping exist.
